description: Figure 3(b) is a line plot illustrating the BLEU scores over training epochs for three distinct data subsets during the fine-tuning of a GPT-NEO 1.3B model on the target dataset Dt. The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0.0 to 3.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Three lines represent different data groups: “Regular members” (blue solid line with circular markers) begins near 0.03, rises gradually to approximately 0.07 by epoch 3.0; “Members with near-duplicates” (orange solid line with circular markers) starts near 0.02, increases sharply to about 0.25 by epoch 1.0, then continues rising more gradually to approximately 0.36 by epoch 3.0; and “Held-out data” (green solid line with circular markers) begins near 0.02, rises slightly to about 0.04 by epoch 0.5, then remains relatively flat, hovering between 0.03 and 0.04 through epoch 3.0. A legend in the upper right corner identifies each line by color and label.
